editorial.blurb: Kai Sushi delivers exceptional fresh sushi and thoughtful Japanese fare in a genuinely welcoming space where attentive service and generous portions feel like the real deal.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit their Wednesday special for 50% off dine-in sushi, or try the all-you-can-eat deal ($32.90) which includes creative rolls and surprisingly excellent house-made ice cream flavors like matcha and red bean.
